summary: FULL ADMIN-SURFACE SCHEMA-LEAK SWEEP VERIFIED (iter 928). Admin positive control confirms guard now passes admin through on every endpoint. The 1 intentionally-skipped mixed-role endpoint (id_checker_send_message) still allows non-admin authenticated users. critical_code_review_comments: All 14 endpoints (12 in main files + 2 email_notifications overrides + 2 jobs admin) now correctly use Depends(require_admin) as the auth guard — canonical FastAPI pattern that runs BEFORE Pydantic body validation, closing the 422 schema-leak vector.

The 2 /api/jobs/admin/* endpoints legitimately return 410 (Gone) to authenticated non-admin free users because the legacy jobs write-family is retired via a middleware that runs after auth attach but before route dispatch. Anon still gets 401/403 and admin can access; response body contains no schema field names — no security regression, orthogonal to schema-leak fix.

id_verification.id_checker_send_message correctly kept without require_admin — it's a user↔admin messaging endpoint and non-admins must be able to POST there. Verified free user is NOT rejected with an 'admin required' 403.
